value.author: claude-orchestrator
value.text: Record completeness correction appended by the orchestrator after CodeRabbit review (append-only stream, so the closed entries were not edited). The description and close_reason named only the dev and peer dependency scopes, but this package declares @unbrained/pm-cli in all three scopes and the bump touched every one: dependencies ^2026.7.28 to ^2026.7.29, devDependencies ^2026.7.28 to ^2026.7.29, peerDependencies >=2026.7.28 to >=2026.7.29. The runtime dependencies entry is the one with real install consequences, so omitting it from the audit record understated the change. Verified after the fact against package.json rather than restated from the original claim.
